_comment: Append-only ledger of determinism upgrade boundaries (#1702). divergence-allowlist.json entries EXPIRE (compare.rs check_expiry removes them once the previous release reaches introduced_in), but the join restriction they imply never does: a v0.0.27 member must never join a v0.0.29 cluster even after the v0.0.28 allowlist entries are gone. nano-falcon-protocol/build.rs derives the cluster-join boundary table from THIS file and fails the build if any allowlist upgrade-boundary entry is not recorded here, so ratifying a boundary forces the ledger append. Never remove or edit a recorded boundary.
